title: What the brine left open
interpretation: All displayed surfaces are native mineral concentration isosurfaces; no render mask, surface deformation or invented internal mesh. Coordinates are uniformly divided by physical half-extent for photographic staging. Residual A/(A+B) trilinearly sampled at native mineral vertices selects copper-to-verdigris color; saved absolute phase sets roughness 0.40–0.62 and residual ratio sets metallic response 0.12–0.62. These are chosen optical mappings, not an oxidation solve. The selected surface shaders and photographic floor/lights are optical choices, not calibrated material optics. A lower-concentration clear film is included only when no_wet is false.
